description.narrative: The project will (i) upgrade 58 kilometers (km) of national roads from Baucau to Viqueque, with considerations for better resilience to climate change and social inclusive design; and (ii) provide institutional strengthening and capacity building. The project supports continuing efforts of the Asian Development Bank (ADB) and other development partners to upgrade and sustain the country's national road network.

description.narrative: Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Improved and safe Baucau to Viqueque highway Indicator: By 2025: 58km of national road from Baucau to Viqueque are constructed with IRI 2 m/km (2017 baseline: IRI > 8 m/km). Achievement: 11.20 Progress/Status: (i) Physical Progress. According to the physical progress status obtained from MPW/PMU, as of November 2025, Civil works for Lot 1: Baucau - Venilale is 100% completed; while the civil works for Lot 2: Venilale - Viqueque is 78% completed with an elapsed time of 84.20%, based on total length of work scope equivalent to 26.06km. Approximately 7.4 km of civil works under Lot-2 remain incomplete, including the the exception areas: (i) 5.1kmn from Sta. 30+420 to Sta. 35+520; (ii) Sta. 58+000 to Sta. 59+440; and (iii) Sta. 59+720 to Sta. 62+010.
(ii) Proposed Additional Scope (5.1km Venilale-Ossu). In a letter dated 30 September 2024, MPW submitted to ADB a proposed detailed engineering design report for the 5.1km Venilale-Ossu road section which is a proposed additional scope to the project. Through a fax dated 30 October 2024, ADB provided no objection to the detailed engineering design. In addition, ADB requested MPW to address comments provided to the draft supplementary resettlement plan (SRP) and draft supplementary initial environmental examination (SIEE) on 22 and 29 October 2024 and submit revised versions for ADB clearance. This was again emphasized by the project team during the road projects' review missions in June and November 2025. ADB is still awaiting MPW's response and submissions.
(iii) Proposed Variation Orders to Lot 2 Contract. In a letter dated 30 September 2024, MPW requested ADB's no objection to proposed VO.4 to lot 2 civil works contract for another extension of time for completion of works due to (a) delays in handover of section at Sta. 42+920 to Sta. 44+420, resettlement issues, design data error to various sections covering total 18.66km section at Sta. 27+120 to Sta 30+420, Sta. 42+920 to Sta. 58+000, and Sta. 59+000 to Sta 59.720; and (b) additional sections totalling 7.4km at Sta. 30+420 to Sta 42+920, inclusive of the proposed 5.1km (Venilale-Ossu) from Sta 30+420 to Sta. 35+520) additional project scope, and Sta. 35+520 to Sta. 42+920, which was originally given to a local contractor and subsequently given to CRIG-COVEC. The extension will result in revised completion of defect notification period and performance-based maintenance. ADB in a letter dated 14 November 2024 provided its no objection to VO.4 on the condition that MPW meet the requirements it had earlier listed in the fax dated 30 October 2024 (item ii above) related to the proposed 5.1km Venilale-Ossu road section additional project scope.
(iv) DED Consultant Recruitment. The process to recruit the consulting firm which will prepare the needed DED for the Lospalos-Iliomar-Viqueque-Natarbora road section, and four bridges is ongoing. NPC submitted to ADB Submission 1 documents on 2 August 2024. ADB replied and provided comments on 14 August 2024 which included a request to submit a revised set of Submission 1 documents. NPC submitted the revised Submission 1 to ADB on 4 July 2025. ADB replied and provided comments on 14 August 2024 on 5 August 2025. NPC submitted the revised RFP for ADB's review on 12 Dec 2025. Data Source: Annual road condition surveys by DRBFC; project monitoring reports from MPWTC

Output: Improved and safe Baucau to Viqueque highway Indicator: By 2025: At least two bus shelters and separate male and female public toilets constructed in strategic locations along the road (2017 baseline: none) Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: The government has requested ADB to reduce the target for output 1c from “At least five bus shelters and separate male and female public toilets constructed in strategic locations along the road (2017 baseline: none)” to “At least two bus shelters and separate male and female public toilets constructed in strategic locations along the road (2017 baseline: none)”, in recognition of the challenges to public toilets' operations and maintenance requirements faced by the relevant authorities. ADB approved the minor change on 17 March 2025. Data Source: As-built drawings, project progress reports

Output: Improved and safe Baucau to Viqueque highway Indicator: By 2025: Community members (30% women) from each of the villages crossed by the highway participate in combined gender, HIV/AIDS, and STI awareness program during the 3 years of construction (2017 baseline: N/A) Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Lot 1: From 2020 to Mar 2024, total of 22 sessions of health, safety and environment training were held, participated by 442 male and 225 female. From 2020 to Mar 2024, 20 sessions of HIV/AIDS awareness training were conducted which were participated by 372 male and 255 female. From 2022 to 2023, 5 sessions of GBV/SH & VAC awareness training, participated by 84 male and 72 female. Source: CSC report during ADB mission, 18 to 24 June 2024
Lot 2: Health, safety and environment training have been held from 2020 to October 2024 with total of 45 sessions conducted, participated by 712 male and 137 female. Total of 29 sessions on HIV/AIDS awareness training were conducted participated by 420 male and 239 female. Total of 9 sessions of GBV/SH & VAC awareness training were held participated by 108 male and 78 female. Source: CSC report during ADB mission, 18-25 November 2024. Data Source: GAP biannual progress report
